text:
maria-g: quick premerge check on PR #2799 — planning a tiny nit sweep (formatting, imports, two small renames). aiming to land in today's merge window (18:00 PST). Need 1 approval; low-risk. pinging owners.

josh-lee: skimmed — tests good. One concern: import ordering in service/handler.go and a gofumpt diff. also the RequestID -> ReqID rename changes many call sites; prefer keeping RequestID for clarity.

maria-g: yea, I realized the rename ripples. It was to align with proto; proto field is `request_id` so RequestID seemed long. I can revert the rename to avoid churn. Here's the minimal change I have:

```diff
- func NewReqID() string { return uuid.New().String() }
+ func NewRequestID() string { return uuid.New().String() }
```

maria-g: also ran `gofmt` but not gofumpt yet — will run and push.

priya: small nits: repo uses 100 cols and prefers named returns avoided. also add a godoc on ExportedHandler if it's now exported.

maria-g: noted, will add comment and wrap lines. will run `gofumpt -w` and `gci import ./...` locally.

ci-bot: CI: build passed — however, gofumpt check FAILED on commit 3f7b2c. See: https://ci.internal/2799

sam: i'm OOO until 17:30 PST but can review/approve after. if you need faster, @chris-b can give a quick stamp.

chris-b: on it, reviewing now. if you revert the rename and run gofumpt, i can approve. leave TODO to reconcile proto naming later.

maria-g: pushed revert + ran gofumpt + added godoc + wrapped lines. PTAL.

chris-b: thanks — runs fine locally, tests pass. :thumbsup: approving now. will merge during 18:00 window.

priya: tiny follow-up: add `make format` to CONTRIBUTING or a short checklist to avoid future CI churn.

maria-g: agreed. i'll open a follow-up PR for a pre-commit hook and CONTRIBUTING note.

chris-b: merged during window. closing.
